_doc: Original Zeus in-game city UI. Sprite refs {file, index} = atlas index of extracted/sprites/<file>/atlas.json. Panel rects are [x, y, w, h] with x relative to panelX (the panel's left edge) and y from the screen top. See docs/play/ui.md. Generated by tools/play_ui.py from Zeus.exe.

layout.map_view: x in [0, panelX), y in [0, H); the top bar (30 px) is drawn over it

800x600.note: panel image 186 wide drawn at 598, plus a 16x600 edge at 784; panel clipped at 600 rows

640x480.note: exe values only; not a target

layout.larger: the original has no mode above 1024x768. Use the 1024 rules with panelX = W-186: top bar left-anchored (funds/population fixed x), date right-anchored to the panel, panel right-anchored and top-anchored, info windows by the arm64 formulas, menus/submenus relative to panelX; fill top bar and panel bottom as the arm64 host does

background.wide: not original: arm64 host extends x>=838 up to panelX by mirroring the last 500 px

menus.layout: first title at x=10, y=6; each next title starts 10 px after the previous ends (0x004310E0, table 0x005EFF00); font SPR_FONTS_11C; open/hovered title drawn with colour 0xFAC1 and shadow style

dropdown.frame: titled-frame middle tiles (0x0059F0F0) at (title_x, 24), cells = text-group width cells (FUN_00512870), rows = (items+1)*20/16
dropdown.items: text (title_x+8, 30 + 20*i), font SPR_FONTS_11C; hovered: SPR_FONTS_11LTYEL (entry 9), colour 0xFAC1, shadow style

funds.number: at icon x + 16, y 5; font SPR_FONTS_11C (negative: rank 4)

top_bar.wide_rule: the arm64 wide mode keeps the 1024 values (funds 381, population 525) and date at panelX-110

background.note: one 186x768 image with transparent holes for the buttons; the god art at the bottom is part of it; 800x600 clips it at y=600; below 768 rows (wide modes) the arm64 host repeats rows 762..767 (texture only) with a random horizontal shift, keeping the 7-px left border (not original)

control_panel.state_rule: image = group first + offset + (3 if disabled else 2 if selected else 1 if hovered else 0); state byte 2 = not drawn (draw table 0x004316F0)

alerts.name: goto_1
alerts.note: event 'go to' button; drawn only while an alert of that slot is active; the image group is chosen at run time from SPR_BTN_ALERTS_<KIND> (3 images: normal, hover, selected)

alerts.name: goto_2
alerts.note: event 'go to' button; drawn only while an alert of that slot is active; the image group is chosen at run time from SPR_BTN_ALERTS_<KIND> (3 images: normal, hover, selected)

alerts.name: goto_3
alerts.note: event 'go to' button; drawn only while an alert of that slot is active; the image group is chosen at run time from SPR_BTN_ALERTS_<KIND> (3 images: normal, hover, selected)

alerts.name: goto_4
alerts.note: event 'go to' button; drawn only while an alert of that slot is active; the image group is chosen at run time from SPR_BTN_ALERTS_<KIND> (3 images: normal, hover, selected)

rotate.name: rotate
rotate.image_rule: first + (view_rotation/2)*8 + (4 if pressed else 1 if hovered else 0)

page_title.text: group 88 [page] centred in 130 px, font SPR_FONTS_11C

overlay_buttons.label: text group 14 [overlay id], centred in the button width, y = button y + 8 (0x26-0x1e), font SPR_FONTS_9LTBK (font table entry 10)
overlay_buttons.selected_rule: selected when the current overlay (0x00FA05F0) equals the button's overlay id

info_box.frame: plain frame (SPR_MARBLE2) at (50, 300 - hh), 8 cells wide, hh/16 rows; hh = u + 32 - (u & 15), u = (11 - n_overlay_buttons) * 20; drawn when category 0 or page 10

name_bar.text_y: 0x134 (building) / 0x136 (button names), centred in 130 px from x=50, font SPR_FONTS_9DKBU (entry 13)
name_bar.shows: name of the hovered page button (group 88) or build button (group 28) + its cost with SPR_REQUEST_CASH_ICON

build_buttons.image_rule: icon < 33: Zeus_Interface SPR_BUILD_BTNS + 3*icon; else Poseidon_Loaded packed 0x6806 + 3*icon - 99; +1 hover, +2 selected; hidden when the slot has no tool or the tool is not available (0x00787178)

message_strip.note: last message text area (part of the background art); text by another agent

overlays.where: buttons at the top of each control-panel page (category tab 0); space toggles the page overlay

submenu.anchor: right edge of the bars is panelX-5; menu is left of the control panel
submenu.cells_C: ceil(max width of text group 28 strings in font SPR_FONTS_11C / 16) (0x005127F0); English GOG = 15
submenu.row_y: Y0[n] + 0x6E + 24*i, n = number of listed (available) items, i = 0..n-1

bar_tiles.draw: middle tile at x, x+16, ... (cells tiles), then left tile at x and right tile at x+16*(cells-1) (0x0059FBA0)

cost.value: model building cost (model_building_value(tool,0)); not drawn when 0

sanctuary_extra_costs.marble_icon: Zeus_General SPR_GOODS_ICONS (packed 0x87B) + goods index, x=panelX-0x82, dy=+2
sanctuary_extra_costs.drachma_x: panelX - 0xB2 + 16*k (k = 3, 6 or 9 after the extra icons)

submenu.hit: rows [bar_x, row_y, bar_x+16*(C+7), row_y+20) (table 0x005ED1E0); left press selects (build_tool_select 0x00404330)
submenu.close: screen 6 is left by choosing an item, clicking a page button, or right click (returns to screen 1)

11.name: @{t:28:26}
11.items: trade buildings: table 0x005F34BC, label by trade_building_label (city name), listed when FUN_005B9410

21.name: Poseidon Pyramid (god statues)
21.items: god statues of the Poseidon pyramid: table 0x005F4074 -> scenario gods

22.name: @{t:28:157}
22.items: commemorative monuments: index table 0x005F41A0, text group 0xC6 (198), listed only when g_commemorative_available[i]

23.name: @{t:28:125}
23.items: hero halls: table 0x005F42CC, text group 0xB9 (185) index+7, listed when FUN_004FA620

info_window.evidence: exe 0x005715A0 (placement), 0x0056E960 (typical body), table 0x005EF708; seen in oracle shots
info_window.title: text centred in 16*cols at y+10, font SPR_FONTS_22C (entry 6) in 0x0056E960
info_window.workers_box: plain frame (SPR_MARBLE2) at (x+15, y+16*rows-128), cols-2 wide, 5 rows (0x0056E960); the sanctuary window draws it at (x+16, y+388) seen
info_window.button_highlight: window_highlight_draw (SPR_RIMS): e.g. Oracle 'Consult Oracle' 301x32 at (x+75, y+240) seen

figure_slots.note: up to 7 figure thumbnails 50x50 at (x+26+60i, y+46) (hit table 0x005EE858)

titled.s: counter of middle tiles in a row, 0..9 then wraps (ceiling 10)
titled.p: +0xC after each middle row, wraps at 0x78

highlight.tiles: top +0 first, +1 middle, +2 last; bottom +6 first, +5 middle, +4 last; sides +7 left, +3 right; inside not drawn; second variant = +8; last column/row pulled back so the rect is exact

frames.rule: tile (r,c) at (x+16c, y+16r); a WxH panel = cols x rows of 16-px tiles (interface.md 5.3, verified natively by arm64)

minimap.projection: one map tile = 2 pixels wide x 1 pixel tall (iso rows alternate by 1 px: x = left - (row&1)); the 2 pixels are the first 2 pixels of the chosen sprite image (0x00456BA0)
minimap.scroll: centred on the main view, clamped to the map (0x004547C0)
minimap.terrain_status: order and groups read from 0x00454980 (game-mode branch); a few flag names hypothesis

buildings.rule: on the building's draw tile (draw byte bit 0x40): image of the per-type minimap group; piece size (grid_piece & 0xF): 0 -> 2 px of image+0; 1 -> image+1 at y-1; 2..4 -> image+n at y-n; 5 -> image+2 three times; burning buildings tinted 0xF863

minimap.figures: tiles with soldiers/enemies: a 2-px dot (colour by climate, 0x7800/0x3C00/...); gods/monsters/heroes: SPR_R_GOD / SPR_R_MONSTER / SPR_R_HERO (figure types 0x43/0x44/0x45)
minimap.overlays: with an overlay active, buildings use the overlay object's colour function (vtable +0x24 of 0x00641C10[overlay])

tooltip.width: 190 px; 270 px if the text needs more than 2 lines
tooltip.position: 20 px right of the mouse (left of it when mouse x >= screen - width - 20), 50 px below (72 above when y >= 200)

cursors.note: Win32 cursor resources of Zeus.exe (monochrome 32x32), chosen by 0x0050B6F0
cursors.build: no special cursor: the building preview is drawn on the map
